get_config: get the default hyperparameter configuration for training a FLIP model on TPUs
get_config_img: get the default image encoder configuration with a 24-layer ViT transformer
get_config_txt: get the default text encoder configuration with a 12-layer BERT-style transformer
customize_optimizer: customize the adamw optimizer settings like learning rate, weight decay, and beta values
customize_augmentation: customize image and text augmentation settings including crop, flip, and tokenizer options
